title: Speedrun Personal-Best Pace by Split
dataSources: Game sessions (`game:session`), ranked matches (`ranked:match`), co-op invites (`coop:session`), speedrun attempts (`speedrun:attempt`), server events (`server:event`), board-game plays (`boardgame:play`), raid attempts (`raid:attempt`), and daily quest logs (`quest:completion`).
app: Gaming telemetry from platform session APIs, ranked-match exports, co-op schedulers, speedrun splits, server logs, raid trackers, and board-game play records streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=speedrun:attempt
| stats min(split_delta_sec) as best_split_delta_sec avg(split_delta_sec) as avg_split_delta_sec by game split_name
| sort best_split_delta_sec
description: Shows the best and average split delta for each segment of a speedrun route.
value: Split-level pace reveals where time is still available and where you are already close to your personal ceiling.
implementation: Export LiveSplit or similar split data with per-attempt segment deltas and game names.
visualization: Table of best and average split delta by split name.
grandmaExplanation: It logs which parts of a speedrun are closest to your best pace and which still lose the most time.
